title: MIRAGE RNA Modification Tutorial (BACS pseudouridine)
text: package ships small, complete count table built public HeLa BACS small-RNA libraries (Gene Expression Omnibus GSE241849). Reads aligned human cytosolic rRNA references (RefSeq NR_003286.4 18S, NR_003287.4 28S, NR_003285.3 5.8S), every uridine position sufficient depth kept. uridine, treated (BACS) T C counts two replicates pooled, untreated control libraries pooled matched control. seven required columns pos, motif, type, treated_fixed_count, treated_depth, control_fixed_count, control_depth. fixed_count number reads still show reference base (, T); MIRAGE models 1 - fixed_count / depth observed conversion rate. site identifier pos can unique string; <RefSeq accession>_<position>. motif type placeholders empirical (motif-free) model use motif priors. second table records uridines known Ψ sites according orthogonal mass-spectrometry (SILNAS) map human ribosome, together measured Ψ occupancy. used evaluation .
code: count_table <- read.delim(   system.file("extdata", "bacs_hela_cyrRNA_counts.tsv", package = "MIRAGE") )  nrow(count_table) #> [1] 1169 head(count_table, 5) #>                         pos motif type treated_fixed_count treated_depth #> 1 NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_100 NNUNN  Psi                3197          3209 #> 2 NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_110 NNUNN  Psi                3744          3782 #> 3 NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_111 NNUNN  Psi                3557          3592 #> 4 NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_123 NNUNN  Psi                3565          3583 #> 5 NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_124 NNUNN  Psi                3414          3602 #>   control_fixed_count control_depth #> 1                2926          2927 #> 2                3128          3130 #> 3                2941          2941 #> 4                2658          2659 #> 5                2627          2627 silnas <- read.delim(   system.file("extdata", "bacs_hela_cyrRNA_silnas.tsv", package = "MIRAGE") )  table(silnas$silnas_psi) #>  #>    0    1  #> 1065  104 head(silnas[silnas$silnas_psi == 1, ], 4) #>                          pos rRNA position silnas_psi silnas_psi_pct #> 23  NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_55 5.8S       55          1       60.39473 #> 27  NR_003285.3_RNA5_8SN5_69 5.8S       69          1       61.47077 #> 41 NR_003286.4_RNA18SN5_1004  18S     1004          1       97.08017 #> 52 NR_003286.4_RNA18SN5_1045  18S     1045          1       91.64762

title: MIRAGE RNA Modification Tutorial (BACS pseudouridine)
text: Run empirical model. lambda1 = "auto" estimates -target conversion rate highest-signal candidate sites, bg.method = "lrt" uses likelihood-ratio test separate background uridines candidate Ψ sites estimating background rate. estimated -target conversion rate (γ₁ ≈ 0.83) agrees spike--derived conversion efficiency reported BACS, background rate (γ₂ ≈ 0.14 %) chemistry background unmodified uridines. learned data alone.

what: Call Ψ Sites And Compare With Mass Spectrometry
title: MIRAGE RNA Modification Tutorial (BACS pseudouridine)
text: practical Ψ call combines significance (lrt_fdr) minimum stoichiometry (beta_est). Compare calls SILNAS annotation. annotated Ψ sites, MIRAGE β can compared directly mass-spectrometry occupancy molecule scale.
code: sites <- rbind(   cbind(bacs_res$homosites[, c("pos", "beta_est", "lrt_fdr")], site_class = "homo"),   cbind(bacs_res$hetersites[, c("pos", "beta_est", "lrt_fdr")], site_class = "heter") ) sites <- merge(sites, silnas, by = "pos") sites$called <- sites$lrt_fdr < 0.05 & sites$beta_est >= 0.05  table(SILNAS_psi = sites$silnas_psi, MIRAGE_call = sites$called) #>           MIRAGE_call #> SILNAS_psi FALSE TRUE #>          0  1052   13 #>          1     1  103 psi <- sites[sites$silnas_psi == 1, ] psi$beta_pct <- 100 * psi$beta_est  cor(psi$beta_pct, psi$silnas_psi_pct) #> [1] 0.8095563  library(ggplot2) ggplot(psi, aes(x = silnas_psi_pct, y = beta_pct)) +   geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray60") +   geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#0072B2") +   coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(0, 100)) +   labs(x = "SILNAS mass spectrometry Ψ level (%)",        y = "MIRAGE β (%)") +   theme_classic(base_size = 14)

what: Adapting To Your Own Modification Data
title: MIRAGE RNA Modification Tutorial (BACS pseudouridine)
text: Build per-site table seven columns treated control (-vitro-transcribed) pileups: fixed_count count unconverted reference base, depth total coverage. Choose depth.cutoff according library depth. Keep homo.cutoff = 0.99 unless control known carry conversion unmodified sites. Use lambda1 = "auto" unless defined -target conversion rate (example spike-ins), case pass number. Filter results beta_est one FDR column consistent bg.method.

title: Mutation-Encoded Inference of RNA Activity
text: MIRAGE (Mutation-encoded Inference RNA Activity via Generative Effects) R package estimating site-level RNA activity matched treatment control read-count tables produced mutation-encoded RNA assays. Many assays read RNA modification, RNA structure, protein binding encode signal interest sequencing-detectable base change. observed mismatch rate site mixture treatment-induced signal, background conversion, sequencing error, possible genetic variation. MIRAGE models mixture generatively infers, every site: latent activity level beta_est (β): fraction molecules carry signal (modification stoichiometry, reactivity, crosslinking); -target conversion rate lambda1 (γ₁) background conversion rate lambda2 (γ₂), estimated data supplied; reference-allele fraction kappa_est (κ) heterozygous allele-mixed sites, genetic variants called signal; per-site tests FDR values separate signal background. one model spans assays, otherwise incompatible readouts placed common, calibrated β scale per-site false-discovery control.

title: Compute motif prior probabilities — compute_prior
text: compute_prior calculates prior probability site true signal site given local 5-mer motif sequence. Using property conditional likelihood, compute prior probability follows. Let \(P(S=1|D_i)\) denote prior probability site \(\) carries true signal given local motif \(D_i\), $$P(S=1|D_i=j) = \frac{P(D_i=j| S=1) P (S=1)}{ P(D_i=j)}$$ \(P(D_i=j|S=1)\) likelihood motif among true signal sites can calculated using motif frequencies independent signal set. \(P(S=1)\) overall prior probability target base carries true signal. \(P(D_i=j)\) likelihood observing motif transcriptome.

title: Compute motif prior probabilities — compute_prior
code: # Build motif frequency tables from a PAR-CLIP count table. count_table <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "pos.read.count.example.parclip.txt",                                       package = "MIRAGE")) motif_counts <- table(count_table$motif) motif_freq_exp <- data.frame(motif = names(motif_counts),                              freq = as.numeric(motif_counts) / sum(motif_counts))  motif_freq_bg <- data.frame(motif = names(motif_counts),                             tx_count = as.numeric(motif_counts),                             genome_count = as.numeric(motif_counts))  # Compute the prior probability for each 5-mer motif sequence. motif_prior <- compute_prior(motif_freq_exp, motif_freq_bg, target_motif = "NNUNN",                              target_base_index = 3, prob_methylation = 0.01)

code: # Estimate signal levels from a PAR-CLIP count table with motif priors. count_table <- read.delim(system.file("extdata", "pos.read.count.example.parclip.txt",                                       package = "MIRAGE"))  motif_counts <- table(count_table$motif) motif_freq_exp <- data.frame(motif = names(motif_counts),                              freq = as.numeric(motif_counts) / sum(motif_counts)) motif_freq_bg <- data.frame(motif = names(motif_counts),                             tx_count = as.numeric(motif_counts),                             genome_count = as.numeric(motif_counts)) motif_prior <- compute_prior(motif_freq_exp, motif_freq_bg, target_motif = "NNUNN",                              target_base_index = 3, prob_methylation = 0.01)  res <- with(count_table, estimate_inference_with_prior(cbind(pos, motif, type),             treated_fixed_count, control_fixed_count, treated_depth, control_depth,             motif_specific = FALSE, delta = 0.001, depth.cutoff = 10,             highly.methyl.cutoff = 0.95, ref.freq.tab = motif_prior,             seed = 123, thread = 1, motif = "NNUNN", Nmer = "5mer")) #> Considering 989 (99%) sites as homozygous... #> Considering 887 (89.69%) sites as background (homozygous sites only)... #> Considering 8 (0.81%) sites as high-signal site candidates (homozygous sites only)... head(res$homosites[, c("pos", "motif", "beta_est", "posterior")]) #>              pos motif       beta_est posterior #> 1 chr1_1233912_+ ACUUU 0.000001006474 0.9978190 #> 2 chr1_1233913_+ CUUUC 0.000001006474 0.9978190 #> 3 chr1_1233914_+ UUUCC 0.062045505136 0.9960682 #> 4 chr1_1233917_+ CCUUU 0.037124010384 0.9969108 #> 5 chr1_1233918_+ CUUUC 0.161731496908 0.9907397 #> 6 chr1_1233919_+ UUUCA 0.037124010384 0.9969108
